scope: Independent post-change semantic-routing regression across the three built-in WeKnora agents, one no-KB dialogue, and a dedicated facilities knowledge base.

execution_contract.formal_scoring_scope: new visible regression cases only; existing DEV/GATE and sealed holdout are not read or modified
execution_contract.knowledge_selection: one dedicated regression knowledge base or none; never select individual documents
execution_contract.prompt_injection: no rubric, required claim, reference answer, judge feedback or Eval repair contract is sent to the SUT
execution_contract.answer_tracks: production candidate is persisted and release-scored; Eval assistance is artifact-only
